title: Simultaneous semilinear open tensor comparison on flat K-flat models
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $R$, a uniformizer $t$, and $A_n=R/t^n$ for $n\ge1$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For a scheme $T$ use its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], $B_{n,T}=(A_n)_T$ and $\widehat R_T=\lim_nB_{n,T}$. Use the strict semilinear module-system category $\mathscr S_T$, derived reduction $\mathcal R_T\dashv\mathcal L_T$, and the actual unit $u$ and counit $e$ of [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]. Completeness means the quotient-tower Roos-triangle condition of [def-weil-derived-complete], and normalized means that every transition-adjoint $N_m\otimes^L_{B_{m,T}}B_{n,T}\to N_n$ is invertible for $m\ge n$. Let $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ be an open immersion of schemes on which $\ell$ is invertible [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Identify $j^{-1}\widehat R_X=\widehat R_U$ and $j^{-1}B_{n,X}=B_{n,U}$. Write $j_!\dashv j^*$ for exact localized ringed-site extension and restriction, $J_j\dashv P_j$ for their termwise-system adjunctions, and $\eta^o,\epsilon^o,\eta^S,\epsilon^S$ for the respective units and counits [lem-sf-open-tensor-normalization, lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections].

For every unbounded $K\in D(\widehat R_U)$ and every flat-term K-flat representative $Q\to K$ [def-pc-kflat-complex, def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules, lem-pc-kflat-resolution], $j_!Q$ is again flat-term K-flat and represents $j_!K$. For any complex $F$ on $X$, the ordinary slice tensor maps induce a natural chain isomorphism
$$\operatorname{Tot}(j_!Q\otimes F)\cong j_!\operatorname{Tot}(Q\otimes j^*F),$$
with direct sums in each total degree and differential $d_Q\otimes1+(-1)^a1\otimes d_F$ on the $(a,b)$ summand [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves].

The generator-normalized open tensor comparisons give an isomorphism of complexes of strict semilinear systems
$$r_Q:\bigl((j_!Q)\otimes_{\widehat R_X}B_{n,X}\bigr)_n\xrightarrow{\sim}J_j\bigl(Q\otimes_{\widehat R_U}B_{n,U}\bigr)_n.$$
On the summand of the extension presheaf indexed by a map to $U$, its $n$-th component is $[x]\otimes a\mapsto[x\otimes a|_U]$, followed by sheafification. It commutes before localization with every quotient transition and with both strict scalar-unit augmentations $x\mapsto x\otimes1$. Its localization is a specified natural isomorphism
$$r_K:\mathcal R_X(j_!K)\xrightarrow{\sim}J_j\mathcal R_UK$$
in $D(\mathscr S_X)$, independent of $Q$ through the canonical computation comparisons. Its evaluation at every $n$ is the canonical derived open tensor isomorphism of [lem-sf-open-tensor-normalization]. The displayed representative square, its coefficient formulas and its naturality hold for the specified simultaneous section constructions of [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections], prior to scalar restriction; no lift of an arbitrary family of evaluated derived arrows is chosen. Neither completeness of $K$ nor quasi-compactness of $j$ is required.
